doc.title: Skitch Henderson interviewed by Monk Rowe, New Milford, Connecticut, October 31, 1998

title: Hearing the Miller band and Woolsey Hall
summary: He heard Miller's military orchestra, later conducted in New Haven where the band formed.

story.theme_name: Drafted: musicians in the military and the war years
story.community_name: Drafted: service bands, USO shows and the war years

blocks.x: And did you get to hear the Miller orchestra?

I recently conducted the New Haven Symphony in Woolsey Hall, and that was where that orchestra was born, the military orchestra. When he broke up his dance band, New Haven was the headquarters. That’s where they brought all of these musicians. Isn’t that wonderful? Ray McKinley, everybody, all of them came there. Zeke Zarchy, oh, wonderful, wonderful players, friends of mine, were all in that. I thought of conducting that orchestra on this stage, and I looked at those long hairs in the symphony and I tried to say to them, “Do you have any idea what went on on this stage?”
